decision: Do not ship or activate this adapter. Preserve the clean pinned base path while moving the useful semantic behavior into the model-neutral compiler.
claimBoundary: This receipt proves that the exact rank-8 candidate failed the declared semantic and efficiency admission bars. It does not prove that LoRA adapters cannot help Scion, that the base model is universally superior, or that the automated 99/A canary score is a universal factual-quality judgment.

semanticCheckpointProbe.scope: The frozen 11-row test split was replayed through the exact production prompt and greedy schema boundary. This probe may reject a checkpoint; it may not promote one.
semanticCheckpointProbe.interpretation: Training from step 100 to step 200 restored exact fact-ledger retention from 9/11 to 11/11 and reduced detected issues from 90 to 37. Validation loss therefore tracked some real learning, but neither checkpoint produced one fully admitted held-out kernel. Loss alone was not a promotion signal.

semanticFalseAdmission.defect: A multiple-choice item asked the learner to choose between read() and readlines() without specifying the required return type. Its explanation affirmed both the string-return and list-return options.
semanticFalseAdmission.previousOutcome: The earlier semantic gate admitted the ambiguous item.
semanticFalseAdmission.intervention: Match code-function return relations even when the explanation reorders context before the return verb, while requiring the same function subject and at least 70% returned-object token coverage.
semanticFalseAdmission.newOutcome: The item is quarantined as multiple-affirmative-explanation-options before compilation.

architectureConclusion.reason: A second adapter pass necessarily raises the 16-call base canary above the declared 5% call ceiling and the measured implementation added 14 calls while taking 3.84 times as long.
nextAllowedShape: Replace an existing generation call for an exact task family, with no second pass.
Use deterministic compiler projection when the exact admitted fact ledger already exists.
Keep any future adapter inactive until multi-domain artifact evidence clears semantic, repair, runtime, memory, browser, download, and export bars.
